description: This Java class 'InputManagerV9' manages input devices, tracks device connection status, and notifies listeners of device events such as addition, change, or removal. It includes device polling and disconnect detection logic.

classes.name: InputManagerV9
classes.description: Main class managing input devices and device event notifications.

classes.name: PollingMessageHandler
classes.description: Handler subclass that periodically checks for device disconnections.

classes.name: DeviceEvent
classes.description: Runnable class representing device connection/disconnection events.

methods.name: InputManagerV9
methods.description: Constructor initializing device tracking and starting device polling.

methods.name: getInputDevice
methods.description: Returns the InputDevice object for a given device ID.

methods.name: getInputDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns array of current input device IDs, updating internal device list.

methods.name: registerInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for input device events with specified handler.

methods.name: unregisterInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Removes a registered input device listener.

methods.name: notifyListeners
methods.description: Notifies registered listeners of device events.

methods.name: onGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Detects new devices from motion events and updates device list.
